scope: Scripted PIE setup followed by unmodified AI, navigation, projectile collision and player-damage observation; not a human playthrough.

setup.action: position at authored weapon rack and call AcquireWeapon
position stationary observer; leave all enemy AI active

limitations: Weapon acquisition uses AcquireWeapon at the rack, not simulated interaction input.
The observer does not assign damage, health, enemy state, movement destinations, or attack timings.
Health loss is attributed to normal enemy projectiles by the observed spawned projectile actors and unchanged damage code; no per-hit delegate is injected.
